messages:
maria: quick check — audit/event coverage triage for api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. need owners for schema changes, KMS metadata, and customer-facing validation before next sprint.
ajay: tagging in infra
ajay: who's the owner for api-gateway logs? @leo?
leo: yep i'll take gateway. high level: missing fields for RBAC change (actor.role) + no kms_key_id recorded for key rotation events
sophie: i'll own console + billing. note: billing already emits invoice.events but missing requester.ip and auth_method
maria: PRIO: ensure schema accommodates RBAC role migration (user_id -> actor.{id,role,kind}) and KMS context (kms_key_id, encrypted_meta = bool). customers ask for immutable evidence for audits.
samir: quick Q — do we need to store full encrypted payloads, or just metadata referencing encrypted blobs in S3? depends on retention/KMS costs.
leo: prefer referencing encrypted blobs; keep events lean. add 'evidence_ref' field and 'evidence_hash'
sophie: agreed. customer-facing proof can be built from evidence_ref + signed hash.
maria: propose schema v2 draft below — feedback pls:

```
{
  "event_id": "uuid",
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "actor": {"id":"uuid","role":"string","kind":"user|service"},
  "action":"string",
  "resource":{"type":"string","id":"string"},
  "auth_method":"oauth|api_key|sso",
  "requester_ip":"ipv4|ipv6",
  "kms_key_id":"string|null",
  "evidence_ref":"s3://...|null",
  "evidence_hash":"sha256|null",
  "version":"v2"
}
```

leo: looks good. we should also include 'service' top-level so cross-service queries easier — e.g., service: "gateway" or "runtime"
ajay: infra note — we need KMS IAM perms for the platform service account. cc: @kate from infra-iam
kate: I can follow up. we'll create a short RBAC policy for KMS decrypt/describe limited to evidence bucket
security-bot: Reminder: SEC-4321 exists for audit schema changes, link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-4321
sophie: backlog items (rough): LOG-221 add schema v2 + migration path; INFRA-987 evidence storage + kms perms; UX-314 customer audit validation API
maria: can we agree owners and ship plan? thinking: (1) schema PR this sprint (owner: leo + sophie) (2) infra perms & evidence refs (owner: kate + ajay) (3) customer validation API + docs (owner: sophie) (4) migration/compat layer for old events (owner: samir)
samir: I can do migration layer; plan: preserve user_id for 6 months and populate actor.* going forward. will emit conversion map.
leo: estimate: schema PR + tests 3d, runtime wiring 4d, deploy & e2e 2d
maria: sounds good. add items to SEC-4321 and link sub-tasks. sprint pickup meeting tmrw 10am. :calendar:
ajay: noted. I'll prep infra checklist for KMS rotation playbook and link to INFRA-987
kate: will assign IAM tickets and tag security review
sophie: adding UX acceptance criteria: customer API endpoint to fetch event + evidence_ref + signed hash; need a signed URL flow
maria: ok — action items recap: leo+ sophie = schema PR (LOG-221), kate+ajay = infra/KMS perms (INFRA-987), samir = migration (SEC-4321#sub1), sophie = customer API + docs (UX-314). aim: draft PRs by EOD Thu
leo: will open draft PR today
security-bot: Deploy-bot: new patch branch created: branch/audit-schema-v2 by leo
maria: thanks all. ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
